# spiceai_container_images (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of available Spice.ai runtime container images.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `channel` (String) Release channel to filter by (`stable` or `enterprise`). Defaults to `stable`.

### Read-Only

- `default` (String) The default image tag.
- `images` (Attributes List) List of available container images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `channel` (String) The release channel (`stable` or `enterprise`).
- `name` (String) The full image name (e.g., `spiceai/spiceai:1.5.0-models`).
- `tag` (String) The image tag (e.g., `1.5.0-models`).
